label: Mockup frame (coloured paper panel under a product)
description: The coloured paper panel a product mockup sits on in a hand-made brand film (the Quotient rebrand's framed mockup): a full-frame background (default cream #FFEFDE), a flat panel of brand colour (default brick #A34735) whose edges are bitten a pixel or two like handled construction paper, and a math-symbol field (+ - x / = and the plus-minus, cream) poking out from under the window at the top right and the bottom left; a few symbols flip into their partners every flip_every seconds. Give it the WINDOW, the box the product will fill ({x, y (centre), w, h} fractions of the box, default {x:0.5, y:0.5, w:0.8, h:0.72}); the panel pads it by `pad` (0.06) of the panel's width. Then place the product component on that same box, ABOVE this one in the stack (a full-frame slot is the 1960x1120 camera layer, so convert: position x = (window.x - window.w/2) and so on, in % of the frame). The root publishes data-window-box and data-panel-box ("cx,cy,w,h" fractions). It appears as a cut at `at` (0). Example: {"color":"#A34735","window":{"x":0.5,"y":0.5,"w":0.8,"h":0.72}}.

window.label: The product's box: {x, y (centre), w, h} fractions of the component box

pad.label: Panel padding around the window, fraction of the panel's width

symbols.label: The two symbol fields at the corners

flips.label: A few symbols flip into their partners on a cadence

wear.label: How far the edge wanders, px
